svg.text: Refined Stack Fractions: From Flat i32 Boxes to Dependent Number-Line Cups
Codillon draws each instruction's stack effect as inputs above a bar and outputs below; refinements turn 30×11 boxes into 84×14 number lines.
1. Codillon Stack-Fraction Idiom (1:1 Editor Scale vs. Refined Number-Line Scale)
B. Refined i32 (84×14 px) — Valid Seat
Purple region = admitted subset of i32
Dark-red hatch spills over cup rim!
2. Magnified Anatomy of a Dependent Result Cup: Gcd(a, b) = { g ∈ ℕ | Div(g) = Div(a) ∩ Div(b) }
Unique g with Div(g) = {1, 2, 4} is g = 4 (returned 4 seats in socket)
